interface_finding: Profiler normal-mode exporter registers atexit.close; its public RuntimeLifecycleHooks.close performs real bounded drain, but the plugin exposes no normal public facade to close its saved hooks. close_native_event_sink only unregisters EventBus and does not flush. Host EventSink has emit only, Scheduler.shutdown does not close sinks, and MPClient forwards timeout=0 to subprocess shutdown, which can force-kill before EngineCore close/atexit completes.
causal_strength: Actual raw shutdown logs and missing summary support an incompatible shutdown/flush lifecycle boundary. They do not prove exactly how many records were lost, nor prove an algorithm or MOD-pair conflict.

next_minimal_real_fix_candidate.public_profiler_boundary: Expose process-local close/drain on the registered NativeLifecycleEventSink (delegating to its existing RuntimeLifecycleHooks.close and returning the real CloseResult), or an equivalent public plugin facade that uses only the already registered hooks without auto-registering a new exporter.
next_minimal_real_fix_candidate.Host_actual_callsite: Invoke the registered observer drain after final real scheduler lifecycle emissions and before terminating its process, using a public opt-in shutdown callback; do not make core Host import a particular MOD or generate a summary itself.
next_minimal_real_fix_candidate.parent_lifecycle_budget: The actual parent must wait long enough for the exporter existing 2-second bounded close plus real acknowledgement/exit; immediate timeout=0 force-kill cannot guarantee this. Preserve a hard finite upper bound and fail/unknown on timeout, not synthetic success.
next_minimal_real_fix_candidate.lower_scope_followup: A new matched cohort may first measure whether an explicitly nonzero supported Host shutdown timeout allows existing atexit to complete. It is an execution-configuration change requiring a new freeze and does not repair or relabel current r4.
next_minimal_real_fix_candidate.prohibited: No sidecar-crafted summary, no inferring zero drops from the four present events, no mutation/rewrite of this cohort or loader.

current_verdict.functional: bounded actual HTTP and Host relations supported
